entities.summary: The Rockefeller Archeological Museum, formerly the Palestine Archaeological Museum, is an archaeology museum located in Jerusalem, next to Herod's Gate, that houses a large collection of artifacts unearthed in the excavations conducted in the British-ruled Mandatory Palestine, mainly in the 1920s and 1930s.
